summary: Asia mostly steadied on Monday 2 November after Friday's US tech and AI selloff (S&P 500 -1.8%, Nasdaq -2.9%, Intel -28.6%): the Kospi rose 2.2%, the Shanghai Composite 1.1%, the Hang Seng 0.5% and the Sensex 1.3%, while the Nikkei fell 0.3%, the ASX 200 0.6% and the Taiex 0.7%, and US futures were higher. Brent fell about 2.8% to $110.24 and US crude 3.1% to $100.85 on reports of US-Iran talks in Qatar over reopening the Strait of Hormuz, after Brent's Friday close near $113. South Korea's October exports hit a record $115.3 billion (+93.7%), with semiconductors at $56.4 billion (+259%), while China's October factory activity returned to contraction. EU gas storage was 74.93% full on 26 October, the lowest for the date since 2011; Apple and Palantir report after the US close, with US midterms and the RBA on Tuesday.

climate.headline: Panama Canal keeps Neopanamax draft at 49 ft and adds slots from 15 Oct
climate.detail: Canal authority cites Gatun Lake level and near-average rain but says a watershed water deficit continues; 33 daily slots from 15 October. FEWS NET flags a drier Central America Dry Corridor.

climate.headline: Typhoon Champi leaves one dead and about 56,000 Taiwan homes without power
climate.detail: Storm passed Taiwan's northeast on 23 Oct with 259 flights cancelled on 24 Oct; Okinawa lost power to about 8,400 households and Shanghai evacuated tens of thousands.

climate.headline: EU gas storage 74.93% full on 26 Oct, lowest for the date since 2011
climate.detail: About 82.1 bcm held, 14.65 points below the five-year average. Rhine at Kaub rose from 26 cm to 52 cm on 26 Oct, forecast near 77 cm around 29 Oct, likely temporary.
climate.source: GIE data via TASS, 28 Oct 2026; Rhine via Cruise Passenger, 26 Oct 2026

climate.headline: El Niño and positive Indian Ocean Dipole raise Horn of Africa flood and southern Africa drought risk
climate.detail: FEWS NET expects above-average Oct-Dec rain in bimodal East Africa, weak Sahel rains, and below-average Oct-Mar rain in southern Africa, with food insecurity peaking in 2027.

climate.headline: NOAA El Nino Advisory: Nino-3.4 at +2.1C, strong event more than 83% likely through Jan-Mar
climate.detail: Issued 8 Oct; chance of a record 3-month index of +2.5C or more is 83% for Oct-Dec. Next update 12 Nov. Australia's Bureau of Meteorology declared El Nino in June.

climate.headline: India monsoon ended 12.6% below normal; northeast monsoon began 15 Oct
climate.detail: Season rainfall 759.4 mm versus a normal 868.6 mm, attributed mainly to El Nino; the northeast monsoon matters for rabi crops in the south.
climate.source: India Meteorological Department via Business Standard, 15 Oct 2026

climate.headline: Indonesian palm oil areas under half of normal rain; 2027 output seen down about 9%
climate.detail: Sumatra and Kalimantan dry since late June; low Kapuas River blocked tanker movements. Industry group sees 2027 output at 53.69 Mt versus 58.8 Mt in 2026.
climate.source: DTN Ag Weather Forum citing Indonesia Palm Oil Association, 23 Oct 2026
